conclusion: Grouped INT4 lm head plus an 8.0GB low-VRAM residency cap improved GPT-OSS ThinTensor to 6.68 tok/s and promoted packed expert layer 12, cutting selected-expert H2D to 127.96GB for the 200-token run. This is still only 0.133x of the same-model llama.cpp Q4_K_M Vulkan baseline, so the remaining target is to reduce streamed packed-expert traffic rather than tuning launch flags.
